tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window itself. The roster and the rail sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The reading panel that floats on ground: a bot's chat, a settings screen. Carries shadow-panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on top: cards, the composer, the selected roster row. Carries shadow-raise.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float above everything: menus, pickers, dialogs. Carries shadow-float.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells pressed into a surface: text inputs, drafts, segmented controls. Carries shadow-well.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: A soft tint on top of any surface: secondary buttons, chips, key hints, your own message bubble, hover on rows and options.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: A stronger tint: bot avatars, hover on a filled button, the chosen segment.

tokens.name: pebble
tokens.usage: The body of a bot's face, on ground and every surface: the colour grey, and the colour of a bot without one. The eyes on it are ink. A face with another colour sets pebble to that colour's token.

tokens.name: pebble-sky
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour sky (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-teal
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour teal (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-moss
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour moss (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-sand
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour sand (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-copper
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour copper (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-rose
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour rose (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pebble-lilac
tokens.usage: A bot's face in the colour lilac (step 7a). The eyes on it are ink, at least 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: provider-claude
tokens.usage: Claude's mark on a helper's row, its own colour. Only for that mark.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: A hairline between groups inside one surface, only where spacing alone is not enough. Never around anything.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The off state of a switch. 3:1 against the surfaces and against its white knob.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, every surface and every fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground, every surface and every fill: activity lines, hints, card text, chips.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders and section titles on ground and the surfaces. On a fill, use ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour. Fill of the primary button, the send button and a switch that is on. Carries on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of an accent control. Carries on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text or as a mark on ground and the surfaces: links, the working mark, the thinking dots.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent-text, such as a chosen option.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Waiting for you. The waiting mark and its word, on ground and the surfaces. Never for decoration.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Halo of the waiting mark.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Blocked, denied and destructive. The blocked mark, its word and the danger button label, on ground and the surfaces.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Hover tint of a danger button.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Tint behind a line that was added, in a change's diff. A + sign beside it carries the meaning too.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Tint behind a line that was removed, in a change's diff. A - sign beside it carries the meaning too.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Shown for keyboard use only.

tokens.name: frame-ground
tokens.usage: The plain light ground behind an artifact's frame, the way a browser tab starts. An artifact page paints its own colours over it; while it loads, a dark page never shows light text on nothing.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind a dialog.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the greeting on Today, empty states.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and the bot name in a chat header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The prep is at 08:30 tomorrow. Nothing is sent until you say so.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card titles and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status words, chips, section titles in the sidebar.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Timestamps, key hints, machine names, durations.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; the gap around the reading panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between an avatar and its text; between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; sidebar and rail padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between messages; padding of the reading panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a settings or Today screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of a screen; around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The largest pause: above a display line.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, key hints, small buttons, options in a menu.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, roster rows, drafts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and pickers, message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The reading panel, the composer, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pebble
tokens.usage: Bot avatars only. The soft square is the bot's shape.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status marks, the send button, switches.

shadow.note: Shadows and lightness do the work borders would do. Each surface has its own shadow. In the dark theme a faint highlight along the top edge stands in for depth.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The reading panel on ground. Goes with surface.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, the selected roster row. Goes with surface-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, pickers and dialogs. Goes with surface-overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Wells pressed into a surface. Goes with surface-sunken.

duration.note: How long things take. Feedback is instant, arrivals are calm, only status marks loop.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback: a button settling under the pointer.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, switches, and every exit.

tokens.name: dur-calm
tokens.usage: Arrivals: a message, a card, a menu.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Screen changes and a card settling into Done.

tokens.name: dur-breath
tokens.usage: One full breath of the working mark.

tokens.name: dur-shine
tokens.usage: One slow sweep of light over the words of the work line while the bot works in it (step 7a).

tokens.name: dur-hold
tokens.usage: How long a press is held to choose the other way: on a phone, holding the send button while a bot works sends the message the other way (steer or queue).

easing.note: How things move. Quick to start, soft to land.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Arrivals and anything answering a click. Starts at once, lands softly.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Colour changes, moves between two resting places.

tokens.name: ease-breath
tokens.usage: The working mark's loop. An even in and out, like breathing.
